card.name: Late-20th-century year digits
card.fires_on: The position just before or inside a 1900s year (the space before 1980s, the 9 in 1991 or 1994, the comma before 1995). It is mostly in older reports and dated documents.

modes.label: Inside a 1900s year
modes.description: The 9 in a year like 1991 or 1994, right after the digit 1.
